review_kind: Static reverse engineering of exact reference binaries; not a target execution test.
conclusion: Both reference clients support AIDL detection and a HIDL 2.2 path. No unavoidable AIDL/HIDL protocol mismatch is established.
remaining: Run on the actual device to confirm published ro.board.first_api_level=30, HIDL registration, linker variants and SELinux access.
Verify framework/JNI/perfservice hint behavior and resource IDs with the stock backend.
Check all optional system-perf components against the stock services; the central client fallback does not prove every component compatible.
